title: Renewal After Rollover Within the Grace Period: Small Business Electricity Supply Representative Tool
content:
A business whose Small Business Electricity Supply agreement has rolled over to month-to-month and which accepts its renewal offer inside the grace period takes the plan and the term offered in the final options notice, its renewal election becomes accepted, and the renewed term carries the grace-period renewal rate worked out for that acceptance. The renewed term starts on the acceptance date and ends on the day before the same calendar day the renewed term's months later; when that calendar day does not exist in the target month, the last day of that month is used before the day is subtracted. A renewal accepted after the agreement has rolled over earns no renewal loyalty credit, the loyalty credit being reserved for renewals accepted on or before the contract end date.

## Renewed term dates (hypothetical)

| Acceptance date | Term offered | Renewed term starts | Renewed term ends |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9 January 2027 | 12 months | 9 January 2027 | 8 January 2028 |
| 31 January 2027 | 24 months | 31 January 2027 | 30 January 2029 |

## Tool: `accept_grace_period_renewal_906a45d5`

**Use and capability.** The business's authorized representative accepts the renewal offer on a small business electricity agreement that has already rolled over to month-to-month supply, within the grace period that follows the rollover. The agreement keeps its agreement number and site and returns to a fixed term: the plan name, term length, renewal rate, start date and end date of the renewed term are recorded on it, the renewal election is recorded as accepted with today's date, and the term is marked as explicitly accepted rather than automatically renewed. The representative sees the agreement on the renewed fixed plan at the accepted rate from the renewed term's start date.

**How it is invoked.** This tool belongs to the business. The agent unlocks `accept_grace_period_renewal_906a45d5` and hands it over; the customer themselves, through the business's authorized representative, runs it.

**Parameters.**

- `bizpower_agreement_id`: the agreement number of the rolled-over small business electricity agreement, as shown on the agreement record returned by the agreement lookup.
- `renewed_plan_name`: the official plan the agreement returns to, written exactly as one of: Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable (the month-to-month plan, used only when the offer being accepted names that plan); Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 (the offer names the 12-month fixed plan); Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 (the 24-month fixed plan); Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 (the 36-month fixed plan); Beacon Ridge Business Green 24 (the 24-month renewable plan); Beacon Ridge Business Green 36 (the 36-month renewable plan).
- `term_months`: the length of the renewed term in integer months, without units or decimals (for example 12).
- `renewal_rate_cents_kwh`: the supply rate of the renewed term in cents per kWh, 2 decimal places (for example 8.75), already rounded half up to the cent.
- `new_term_start_date`: the start date of the renewed term, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `new_contract_end_date`: the end date of the renewed term, YYYY-MM-DD.

**Return.** A receipt with `agreement_id`, `status` (`renewal_accepted` when the acceptance was recorded), `plan` (the plan now in force), `term_months`, `rate_cents_kwh` (2 decimals), `term_start`, `term_end` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `accepted_on` (the date the acceptance was recorded, YYYY-MM-DD).
